notes:
Table heading 'West Coast of Scotland.' (line 1825); I put each row's sub-head in coast as 'West Coast of Scotland--<sub-head>'. Fragments are copied whole, leading spaces included.

MARKS: the three asterisk columns sit under '1879, '80, '81.' (line 1829). In marks I kept the spacing measured from the 1879 column, because the position of each star is what gives its year. Read this way:
- all three years: 81, 82, 83, 85, 86, 91, 93, 95, 96, 100, 102, 103, 111, 112, 113, 114, 116.
- 1880 and 1881 only: 84, 87, 90, 98, 101, 110, 117, 119.
- 1879 and 1880 only: 92, 99, 104.
- 1881 only: 109, 115.
- no stars: 88, 89, 94, 97, 105, 106, 107, 108, 118, 120.
That makes 27 stars under 1881, against the 26 returns the text gives (the star on 93 may stand for the bracketed 93/94 pair).

BRACES:
- 93 and 94 share one brace. The height (150), the stars and the keeper W. Crow are printed only on 93's line. Hynish is the shore station for Skerryvore, so they probably cover both, but I gave 94 no keeper, height or marks beyond '{'.
- The braces on 83 group its two keepers, and on 86 its two heights (150 and 62). They are not station marks.

OTHER COLUMN: heights are given as printed. '"' is a ditto for 'ft.', and 'ft.' is printed again at 92. In 119 and 120, '1880,' is the year the station was added (see the lead-in), not a height.
- 119: the type is printed in parentheses '(L.V.)'. 'Isle of' / 'Man' is split across two lines.
- 120: 'do.' (ditto) is most likely 'Isle of Man'. It could be read as also carrying '(L.V.)', but Langness was a lighthouse, so I left type null and put 'do.' in place.

SPELLINGS COPIED AS PRINTED (possible slips):
- 'Island Glass' = Eilean Glas, Scalpay.
- 'Bona, Skye': the Bona light is at Loch Ness, not Skye.
- 'Kyleakin, Rosshire': Kyleakin is on Skye.
- 'Conan Ferry, Loch Eil' = probably Corran Ferry.
- 'Ardnamurchan, Pt. Argyle': I took the name as 'Ardnamurchan, Pt.' and the place as 'Argyle'.
- Also left as printed: 'Rhuvaal' (Rubh' a' Mhàil), 'Lochindaul', 'Skervuile', 'Dhuheartach', 'Chickens Rock', 'Youngclause', 'Maill'.

KEEPERS: I dropped the full stop that ends each name (it's punctuation). 'Alex.' in 98 is kept with its stop. 'Alex Thompson' (83) has no stop after 'Alex', as printed.

Rows 81–120 make 40 stations in all. No light characters are given in this list.
